#en: Uh, I had an "escape pod" of sorts ready to go. I never intended for a suicide run! But still, there was a risk I wouldn't make it.
zh: 呃，我准备了一个类似「逃生舱」的东西。我从没打算自杀式冲锋！但还是有回不来的风险。

#en: Personally, I've always had a fondness for it. It's a place where people work hard, stand their ground, and try to do what's right.
zh: 就我个人而言，我一直挺喜欢它。那是一个人们努力干活、坚守立场、尽力做对事的地方。

#en: I didn't see much reason not to, we were all dead anyway. So, I freed him. After that, things got... blurry. I think I blacked out.
zh: 我看不出有什么理由不这么做，反正我们都死定了。所以我放了他。之后事情就……模糊了。我想我昏过去了。

#en: You already know how we met. Torin tried to claim the station, not knowing it was mine. There was a bit of a fight, but we made up!
zh: 你已经知道我们怎么认识的了。托林想占有这座空间站，不知道它是我的。我们打了一架，但后来和好了！

#en: Hah! Nice try. But I know that's not really your name. Although, I do like the title "Space Adventurer". Might adopt that myself...
zh: 哈！想唬我。但我知道那不是你的真名。不过，「太空冒险家」这称号我倒喜欢。也许我自己也用用……

#en: You came all the way here -- just to tell me that...? Well, alright! But just so you know, these guys won't give up on hunting you.
zh: 你大老远跑来——就为了告诉我这个……？嗯，好吧！但你要知道，这些人不会放弃追捕你。

#en: But it's not a complete loss! I did pull the location for another Listening Post. There's one in the... Kumasi system. On Kumasi VI.
zh: 但也不算全无收获！我确实挖出了另一处监听哨的位置。在……库玛希星系。库玛希VI上。

#en: We can integrate it into your fleet's new ship immediately. I have a feeling you will make for a better custodian for it than Torin.
zh: 我们可以立刻把它整合进你舰队的新船。我感觉你会比托林更会照看它。

#en: This Amp synchronizes neural rhythms with EM-standard systems, allowing a pilot to anticipate recharge needs with greater precision.
zh: 这个增幅能让人神经节律与电磁标准系统同步，让飞行员更精确地预判充能需求。

#en: By amplifying short term recall, allowing someone to count each shot, this Amp helps optimize reload sequences of ballistic systems.
zh: 通过放大短期记忆，让人能数清每一发，这个增幅能优化实弹系统的装填顺序。

#en: I understand, cybernetics aren't for everyone! But there's no reason you couldn't offer members of your crew the chance to use them.
zh: 我理解，赛博格化不是人人适合！但你没理由不让你的船员有机会用它们。

#en: *sigh* I'll admit it, at first, Gren creeped me out a little. You know... with all his veins, and pale skin. And the way he talks...
zh: *叹气* 我承认，一开始格伦让我有点发毛。你知道……满身血管、苍白皮肤。还有他说话的样子……

#en: Hah! We've got a hotel now! Okay, maybe "hotel" is too fancy a word. But still, guess we're on the map as a place people wanna go...
zh: 哈！我们现在有旅馆了！好吧，也许「旅馆」这词太高级。不过，看来我们总算成了人们愿意去的地方……

#en: Added some greenery. Wanted to brighten the place up a bit! People seem to like it. Or at least, they've yet to complain about it...
zh: 添了点绿植。想让这儿亮堂些！大家似乎挺喜欢。至少还没人抱怨……

#en: You remember that mech? This time I made sure it wouldn't activate after we pulled the Control Node. It won't be bothering us again!
zh: 还记得那台机甲吗？这次我确保我们取走控制节点后它不会启动。它不会再来烦我们了！

#en: Believe it or not, I ran into myself! It's only happened once before. Don't think he was this universe's Torin, but still, nice guy!
zh: 信不信由你，我遇到了我自己！以前只发生过一次。我觉得他不是这个宇宙的托林，不过人不错！

#en: You'd think so, wouldn't ya? But scared or not, they know if they hit you enough times, even the most hardy succumb to their weapon.
zh: 你以为会吧？但不管怕不怕，他们知道只要打够多次，再硬的人也扛不住他们的武器。

#en: Ah, yeah. Hah. Um, funny story! You'd think this sorta thing would be avoidable, but apparently not... I ended up destroying my ship.
zh: 啊，是啊。哈。呃，说来好笑！你以为这种事能避免，但显然不能……我把自己的飞船毁了。

#en: It wasn't easy! I mean, I never intended for a suicide run. But still, you can't always rely on your talents to get you out of a jam.
zh: 那并不容易！我是说，我从没打算自杀式冲锋。但话说回来，你也不能总靠天赋脱困。

#en: You could say that... Could even go as far to say that I am intimately familiar with the technology. But, stories for another time...
zh: 也可以这么说……甚至可以说我对这技术熟悉得很。不过，故事以后再讲……

#en: Hopefully these Amps provide just that. Although, no reason to keep them to yourself. Members of your crew may also find them useful!
zh: 希望这些增幅正能提供这个。不过，没理由留着不用。你的船员可能也觉得它们有用！

#en: I'm... not sure. Clearly, those in their ranks are still able to make independent decisions. Otherwise, I wouldn't be here right now.
zh: 我……不确定。显然，他们队伍里的人仍能独立决策。否则我现在就不会在这儿了。

#en: Fair enough! Still, I've made a few notes on my terminal. If you intend to keep attacking the Arrays, I'd suggest you give it a read.
zh: 有道理！不过，我在终端上记了些笔记。你要是打算继续攻打阵列，建议读一读。

#en: They ran. Left me bleeding out in some filthy alley. Didn't even look back. When a security patrol found me, they didn't help either.
zh: 他们跑了。把我扔在肮脏的巷子里流血。连头都没回。安保巡逻队发现我时，也没帮忙。

#en: I joined this company, the Field Surgeons. Kinda like freelance medics, they go around treating people who can't afford real doctors.
zh: 我加入了这家公司，战地医师。有点像自由医师，四处给请不起正经医生的人看病。

#en: I did ask Gren, but his skills are all about ships and their systems. So that's the only kind of data he really knows how to dig for.
zh: 我问过格伦，但他的本事全在飞船和系统上。所以他也只会挖那类数据。

#en: Some spacesuit merchant set up shop here. Paying rent and everything! How about that? Didn't think we'd pull that kind of business...
zh: 有个太空服商人在这儿开店了。还交租金什么的！你看这事！没想到我们还能招来这种生意……

#en: Did you see? Got ourselves a bounty board now. Trackers Alliance must figure our patrons would make good hunters, or maybe targets...
zh: 看到了吗？我们现在有悬赏板了。追踪者联盟大概觉得我们的客人会是好猎手，或者是好目标……

#en: We're doing this by the book. Scan for the facility, eliminate the drones and mechs, collect the Control Node, then back to Stardock.
zh: 我们按部就班来。扫描找到设施，清除无人机和机甲，取走控制节点，然后回星坞。

#en: Works the same, though! If you're planetside, just toss it on the ground to mark a spot, then depending on what the flare signaled...
zh: 但原理一样！你在行星表面时，把它扔到地上标记位置，然后根据信号弹标示的内容……

#en: Here, take this. The location's on there. You know, if you find more Intel Slates, chances are I can find more Post locations for you.
zh: 来，拿着。位置在上面。你知道，你要是再找到更多情报数据板，我多半能给你找到更多监听哨位置。

#en: She engaged the pirates, drew enough away for the colonists to gain the upper hand and win the fight. We were then able to render aid.
zh: 她迎击海盗，引走了足够多的人，让殖民者占上风并赢得战斗。我们随后才得以施救。

#en: If these cores are their tech standard, this "Watchtower" isn't just ahead of the curve, I dare say they're building the curve itself.
zh: 如果这些核心是他们的技术标准，那这个「瞭望塔」不只是领先潮流，我敢说他们就是在创造潮流本身。

#en: Anyway, I've taken the liberty of constructing one of the "Cyberamps"... This one apparently improves an individual's piloting skills!
zh: 总之，我自作主张造了一个「赛博增幅」……这个显然能提升个人的驾驶技能！

#en: They seem to have embedded themselves within corporations, both large and small. Sometimes as investors, other times as "consultants".
zh: 他们似乎已经嵌入大大小小的企业。有时是投资人，有时是「顾问」。

#en: I never saw any clear signs of infiltration. But with Watchtower's reach, I wouldn't be surprised if they had eyes and ears there too.
zh: 我从没看到明确的渗透迹象。但以瞭望塔的触角，他们在那里也有眼线我也不会惊讶。

#en: Then you have Prowlers, the lowest-level field agents. They run small operations. They also receive implants and further conditioning.
zh: 然后是游荡者，最低级别的外勤特工。他们执行小规模行动。也会接受植入体和进一步调教。

#en: At the lowest level, you have Custodians, or new recruits. They follow orders, but aren't trusted with much, and know next to nothing.
zh: 最低一级是管理员，也就是新兵。他们服从命令，但不被托付多少，几乎什么都不知道。

#en: I can't say for sure, but it certainly felt like some of these organizations had deep ties to Watchtower, even if they didn't know it.
zh: 我不能肯定，但感觉有些组织和瞭望塔关系很深，哪怕他们自己不知道。

#en: Also, a warning. This technology is illegal, and will be treated as contraband. But, further upgrades may be able to help with that...
zh: 还有，一句警告。这技术是非法的，会被当作违禁品。但进一步的升级也许能解决这点……

#en: A weapons dealer moved in! Not sure if that's reassuring or concerning, but it's somethin'! And I won't say no to some extra income...
zh: 有个武器商搬进来了！不知道这是让人安心还是让人担心，但总归是好事！而且我不会拒绝额外收入……

#en: In a nutshell, here's my strategy. You don't fly alone anymore. Instead, you get some buddies. You get more ships. You get... a fleet!
zh: 简单说，我的策略是这样。你不再独自飞行。而是有了伙伴。有更多飞船。有……一支舰队！

#en: Now, they didn't launch a comm beacon, so we don't need to worry about reinforcements showing up. But still, we shouldn't dawdle here.
zh: 它们没发射通讯信标，所以不用担心有增援赶来。不过，我们也不该在这儿磨蹭。

#en: Assuming research continues undaunted, I suspect we'll start seeing major breakthroughs in internal, and other cybernetics very soon...
zh: 如果研究不受阻，我猜我们很快就能看到体内赛博格等方面的重大突破……

#en: A mind can process repair strategies faster with this Amp. Allowing a pilot to quickly identify and resolve ship issues even in combat.
zh: 有了这个增幅，大脑能更快处理维修方案。让飞行员即使在战斗中也能迅速识别并解决飞船故障。

#en: And with some help, we managed to extract enough data -- to guide the construction of a new type of neuroamp. Although, not a neuroamp.
zh: 在一些帮助下，我们提取到了足够的数据——用来指导一种新型神经增幅器的制造。不过，它不算神经增幅器。

#en: The process starts with genetic alterations, primarily, neural restructuring. I was told this is to ensure implants integrate properly.
zh: 过程从基因改造开始，主要是神经重构。我被告知这是为了确保植入体正确整合。

#en: I do try to keep us on good terms. I help out with station repairs whenever I can. My way of paying for my board and keep, so to speak.
zh: 我尽量和大家处好关系。能帮就帮空间站维修。算是以此支付食宿吧。

#en: I thought something felt familiar about you! That must be what it was. Well, glad to see someone else made it off that overly wet rock.
zh: 我就觉得你身上有点熟悉！原来是这个。嗯，很高兴看到还有别人离开了那块过湿的石头。

#en: Well... guess there's no harm in sharing. Don't think I mentioned it yet, but I grew up in Neon. Not exactly a nurturing environment...
zh: 嗯……说说也无妨。我好像还没提过，我在霓虹城长大。算不上什么有爱的环境……

#en: There's a whole bunch of people and organizations out there -- whose only job is to find information others would rather remain hidden.
zh: 外面有一大堆人和组织——他们唯一的营生就是找出别人宁愿藏起来的信息。

#en: I've stripped out and removed everything from my ship that's not strictly necessary. Also swapped out some of the more expensive parts.
zh: 我把飞船里一切非严格必要的东西都拆了。还换掉了些比较贵的部件。

#en: Well, well, well. Fancy meeting you in this universe! I just didn't expect us to be meeting with... *snort* with you on your ass again.
zh: 哎呀呀。没想到在这个宇宙碰上你！我只是没想到我们又见面时……*嗤* 你又趴在地上了。

#en: First, there were Watchtower troops. Then the Listening Post wiped its data, but not before transmitting it to an Array for broadcast...
zh: 先是瞭望塔的部队。然后监听哨清除了数据，但在那之前把数据传给了阵列去播发……

#en: We're not exactly old friends, more like colleagues. Not to say I don't like her! On the contrary, I've always found her quite spirited.
zh: 我们算不上老朋友，更像同事。不是说我不喜欢她！恰恰相反，我一直觉得她很有精神。

#en: But before any of that, tell me, do you require any medical attention or supplies? If you have the credits, I am sure I can accommodate.
zh: 但在那之前，告诉我，你需要医疗或物资吗？只要有钱，我肯定能安排。

#en: The parts from those scrapped vessels yielded a decent amount of credits, plus some Watchtower tech. I hope you make good use of it all.
zh: 那些拆解飞船的部件换来了不少钱，还有些瞭望塔技术。希望你能好好利用。

#en: A Skydrop must be launched from a ship that remains in orbit. Would you like to try fitting the Skydrop onto another ship in your fleet?
zh: 空投必须从留在轨道上的飞船发射。要不要试着把空投装到舰队的另一艘船上？

#en: I decided to leave Watchtower, let them believe I was dead, blown up along with my old ship. Seemed easier than explaining I wanted out.
zh: 我决定离开瞭望塔，让他们以为我死了，跟旧船一起炸没了。比起解释我想退出，这样更省事。

#en: But what I didn't know -- is just how varied and niche their tech can be! Body mods, organ replacement, and a whole series of Neuroamps!
zh: 但我不知道的是——他们的技术竟如此多样而小众！身体改造、器官置换，还有一整系列神经增幅器！

#en: And what exactly will we be paying her with...? It certainly won't be Astra, we don't have enough! And she won't work for anything else.
zh: 那我们要拿什么付她……？肯定不是阿斯特拉，我们不够！而她别的都不要。

#en: I've not really met many other Starborn, but she certainly ranks highly on the trustability scale! We can trust her to get the job done.
zh: 我没怎么见过其他星裔，但她的可信度确实很高！可以信她能把事办成。

#en: If Watchtower disables your ship, the fleet needs to notice this and react straight away to protect you! That's the whole point of this.
zh: 如果瞭望塔瘫痪了你的飞船，舰队必须立刻察觉并作出反应来保护你！这就是这套东西的意义。

#en: They called them "Skydrops". Very versatile, very useful! And now, very illegal. Forbidden by the Armistice. At least, for the military.
zh: 他们管这叫「空投」。非常通用，非常有用！而现在，非常非法。停战协议禁止的。至少对军队是如此。

#en: Honestly, I couldn't tell ya! Kinda wish I knew myself... Because however they found you, it's likely the same way they keep finding me.
zh: 老实说，我也说不清！我自己都希望知道……因为不管他们怎么找到你的，多半也是他们一直找到我的方式。

#en: ...Alright, gonna take a stab in the dark on that one. I'm fine. Maybe a little bit hungry. You know, could probably do with a sandwich.
zh: ……好吧，这个我瞎猜一下。我没事。可能有点饿。你知道，来个三明治大概不错。

#en: These guys who attacked you, it wasn't by accident. And if I hadn't intervened, you'd be on your way to a max security prison right now.
zh: 袭击你的那些人不是偶然。我要是没插手，你现在已经在去最高戒备监狱的路上了。

#en: But digging a little deeper, he realized it's a Watchtower signal. A covert signal. Only reason he found it was 'cause of his training...
zh: 但再深挖一点，他发现那是瞭望塔的信号。一个隐蔽信号。他能发现只是因为受过训练……

#en: However, a number of years ago, Watchtower perfected the miniaturization of the Skydrop. This allows for installation into small vessels.
zh: 不过，几年前，瞭望塔把空投微型化做到了极致。这让它可以装进小型飞船。

#en: ...You got za-- You got zapped by the Disruptor. *sigh* Of course that would happen, I should've thought of that... Sorry, that's my bad.
zh: ……你被电——你被干扰器电了。*叹气* 当然会这样，我早该想到的……抱歉，是我的错。

#en: Had a pal look into it, and he figured out what we'll need. A Model 2 -- Fleet-Sync Control Node. And he knows where we can find one too!
zh: 让一个朋友查了查，他弄清了我们需要的。一台2型——舰队同步控制节点。而且他知道去哪儿找！

#en: Then Watchtower grav-jumps in. And they start firing their Disruptors! But you have so many ships, they don't know WHICH one to focus on!
zh: 然后瞭望塔重力跃迁进来。开始发射干扰器！但你有那么多船，他们不知道该盯着哪一艘！

#en: That explains it! We're the "people of interest". This is how they keep finding me, and how they found you! Hmph. Sneaky little rascals...
zh: 这就说得通了！我们就是「关注对象」。他们就是这样一直找到我的，也是这样找到你的！哼。狡猾的小家伙……

#en: Looks like they got Posts and Surveillance Arrays in most systems... They scan every ship that passes, looking for "people of interest"...
zh: 看来他们在大多数星系都有监听哨和监视阵列……扫描每一艘经过的船，寻找「关注对象」……

#en: At first, he thought it might be a distress call. Someone's comms were on the fritz, so they were forced to get creative calling for help.
zh: 起初他以为可能是求救信号。某人的通讯坏了，只好想方设法呼救。

#en: Ah. Yeah. About that! You see, there was a situation! Unavoidable, really. One thing led to another, and... I ended up destroying my ship.
zh: 啊。是啊。关于那个！你看，出了点状况！其实无法避免。事情一件接一件，然后……我把飞船毁了。

#en: Without getting too deep into the nitty-gritty details, let's just say, this time... my talent was at least enough to avoid certain death.
zh: 细节就不细说了，就说这次……我的天赋至少够我避免必死。

#en: This Amp will be expensive to fabricate, but in my humble opinion, well worth the credits. Let me know if you want me to build it for you.
zh: 这个增幅造价不低，但依我浅见，很值这个钱。想让我造就说一声。

#en: And so, the pirates now turned their attention to us. We'd managed to fight them off just long enough -- to jump safely out of the system.
zh: 于是海盗把注意力转向了我们。我们勉强击退他们，刚好够——安全跃迁出星系。

#en: Like he's reaching for something. And it's not all about him. That's rare. People like Torin? They remind me there's still good out there.
zh: 就像他在追求什么。而且不只是为了自己。这很难得。像托林那样的人？他们提醒我世上还有善。

#en: You know, without Torin, Gren, and yeah, you too, not sure I could've turned Stardock into what it is now. So, just wanted to say, thanks.
zh: 你知道，没有托林、格伦，还有，对，你，我不确定能把星坞变成现在这样。所以，只想说声谢谢。

#en: Guess I should ask, you have a preference on the kinda system we should search in? You want somewhere safer, or one crawling with trouble?
zh: 我该问问，你对要搜的星系类型有偏好吗？想要安全点的，还是麻烦成堆的？

#en: Don't worry, these things aren't big enough to carry Disruptors. Still, they can do some damage, so let's take them out as fast as we can.
zh: 别担心，这些东西太小，装不下干扰器。不过它们也能造成伤害，所以我们尽快解决它们。

#en: You deserve some credits for your work, so here. If you wanna destroy more Arrays, just bring me more Intel Slates, and I'll do what I can.
zh: 你的活儿值些钱，拿着。你要是想摧毁更多阵列，就多给我带些情报数据板，我尽力而为。

#en: If you do find the place, make a copy of any data it has collected. At the very least, it might shed some light on what Watchtower's up to.
zh: 你要是真找到那地方，把它收集的数据复制一份。至少能让我们看清瞭望塔在搞什么。

#en: Torin, I'm glad to see you've been taking good care of your ship. Along with the Skydrop system I spent several weeks retrofitting into it.
zh: 托林，很高兴看到你把飞船照料得不错。还有我花了几周改装进去的空投系统。

#en: Installation complete. I've integrated the Control Node into this mainframe. It'll let you manage multiple ships. It should serve you well.
zh: 安装完成。我已把控制节点整合进这台主机。它能让你管理多艘飞船。它应该会很好用。

#en: Regulations state: before providing assistance, medics wait for danger to pass. Harper, however, decided to take a more proactive approach.
zh: 规定是：提供援助前，医护要等危险过去。但哈珀决定采取更主动的做法。

#en: This Amp unlocks deeper levels of strategic thinking. A pilot will find themselves instinctively leading, with improved fleet coordination.
zh: 这个增幅能开启更深层的战略思维。飞行员会本能地指挥，舰队协调也更好。

#en: My life's been a series of unexpected detours. I've learned to roll with the punches, and accept new opportunities as and when they arrive.
zh: 我的人生是一连串意外的转折。我学会了顺其自然，机会来了就接受。

#en: Beyond that, I know Watchtower has a leader. Maybe even more than one. But I know nothing about them. They don't interact with lower ranks.
zh: 除此之外，我知道瞭望塔有个领导者。也许不止一个。但我对他们一无所知。他们不与低层互动。

#en: These particular amps allow me to direct interface with specific Watchtower tech, and also enhance my vision -- beyond normal human limits.
zh: 这些特定的增幅让我能直接对接特定的瞭望塔技术，还强化了我的视觉——超越常人极限。

#en: After that, me and Torin agreed to go our separate ways, forget that we'd ever met. But I couldn't stop thinking about what had happened...
zh: 那之后，我和托林说好各走各路，当作从没认识过。但我一直忍不住想发生的事……

#en: I've managed to gather a little more info on them. It's not much, a lot of it is guesswork really. Still, I think you might find it useful.
zh: 我又收集到一点关于他们的信息。不多，很多其实都是猜测。不过，我想你可能用得上。

#en: There were hull breaches, structural issues. Hell, most of the core systems were just GONE. Took forever to even get the doors functioning.
zh: 有船体破口、结构问题。见鬼，大部分核心系统直接就没了。光让门能用就花了很久。

#en: Turns out, you got 'em all out! Or at least, all the ones that matter. You won't need to worry about Watchtower ambushes anymore! Good job.
zh: 结果，你把他们全清了！至少是全部要紧的。你不用再担心瞭望塔的伏击了！干得好。

#en: Huh. We're actually getting patrons... Starting to feel alive here. People must've noticed your ships out there. Made 'em curious to visit.
zh: 哦。我们真的有客人了……这儿开始有生气了。人们肯定注意到了你那些在外的飞船。让他们好奇想来。

#en: And despite trying to direct Gren to cobble something together out of spare parts, without real Watchtower components, it just didn't work.
zh: 尽管我让格伦用备用零件拼凑了一个，但没有真正的瞭望塔部件，就是不行。

#en: Okay then, if we're going to make this fleet idea work, it's about time we get a move on. Before Watchtower catches us with our pants down.
zh: 那好，既然要让舰队这个主意成真，我们也该动身了。免得被瞭望塔打个措手不及。

#en: So, I kept an eye on Watchtower comm lines. Waited to see if any patrols reported spotting you, or worse, capturing you. Which -- they did!
zh: 所以，我一直盯着瞭望塔的通讯线路。等着看有没有巡逻队报告发现了你，或者更糟，抓到了你。结果——真有！

#en: ...Or at least, it's meant to. But you, hmph, you took that second burst and just kept on going, didn't ya? Took a third to bring you down.
zh: ……或者至少本该如此。但你，哼，你挨了第二发居然还能继续动，是吧？第三发才把你放倒。

#en: Oh, the usual. Ran into Watchtower on the ground, fight in space over an Array. Got some data! You should run Gren's algorithm on the Slate.
zh: 哦，老样子。在地面撞上瞭望塔，在太空为了一座阵列打了一仗。弄到些数据！你那块数据板该用格伦的算法跑跑。

#en: It was a dangerous move, not just for her but for everyone involved. Despite that, I found myself admiring her... She's a brave young woman.
zh: 那是危险的一步，不只对她，对所有参与者都是。尽管如此，我发现自己很钦佩她……她是个勇敢的年轻女人。

#en: It allows for an extraordinary level of data density. Really, none of it follows any known framework or design principles I'm familiar with.
zh: 它实现了极高的数据密度。真的，它完全不遵循我熟悉的任何已知框架或设计原则。

#en: And then, Wardens. The highest rank I ever interacted with. They orchestrate and maintain major operations, and only answer to a select few.
zh: 再往上，是守望者。我接触过的最高军衔。他们策划并维持重大行动，只对少数几人负责。

#en: So, take out that flare I gave you, punch in a request for a Surface Missile, then throw the flare near the exposed portion of the facility.
zh: 那么，拿出我给你的信号弹，输入地表导弹的请求，然后把信号弹扔到设施暴露部分附近。

#en: That gives you time to get your ship powered up again, your shields back online, and back into the fight! You see where I'm coming from now?
zh: 这给你时间让飞船重新通电、护盾重新上线，回到战斗中！现在明白我的意思了吧？

#en: There'll be reinforcements inbound, so just like last time, I'll go lure them away with my ship. Give you a chance to get back on your feet.
zh: 会有增援赶来，所以跟上次一样，我去用飞船把他们引开。给你机会重新站起来。

#en: And there goes Harper. Of course, you've already met her. But this Harper has never met you. So, just be careful with any "Unity talk", okay?
zh: 哈珀走了。当然，你已经见过她。但这个哈珀从没见过你。所以，别随便聊「归一」的事，好吗？

#en: Hm. That's Harper. Stardock belongs to her! As much as it belongs to anyone. She lets a few of us hang out here, provided we don't misbehave.
zh: 嗯。那就是哈珀。星坞是她的！至少比任何人都更像她的。她让我们几个人在这儿待着，前提是别乱来。

#en: I now have the blueprints to fabricate this type of Cyberamp. If you require one, I'll happily provide it for you. All you need do -- is ask.
zh: 我现在有制造这类赛博增幅的图纸了。你要是需要，我很乐意给你提供。你只需要——开口。
